body: This project is a third-party open source desktop client. It provides content from NetEase Cloud Music and Bilibili for study and personal use only, and does not represent the official position of NetEase (NetEase Inc.) or Bilibili.

It talks to the NetEase Cloud Music and Bilibili services through undocumented interfaces. Those interfaces may change or stop working at any time; the developers are not responsible for the resulting failures.

The audio and video it downloads, plays or caches belong to their authors and rights holders. Use them only with permission, and do not use this project for bulk downloading, redistribution or profit.

You are responsible for complying with the laws of your region and with the terms of NetEase Cloud Music and Bilibili. Any dispute, claim or loss arising from the use of this project is yours to bear; the developers accept no legal liability.
This project is provided as is, without any warranty of availability, stability or data integrity. The developers may change, pause or end it at any time without further notice.
To the fullest extent permitted by law, the developers accept no liability for any direct, indirect, incidental or consequential damage caused by the use of, or the inability to use, this project.
